# Compiler and VM Matrix

| Language | Toolchain | SDK integration |
|---|---|---|
| C | GCC/Clang | headers, runtime, CMake |
| C++ | G++/Clang++ | headers, runtime, CMake |
| C# | .NET SDK/Roslyn | managed library |
| Objective-C | Clang | headers/source and target profile |
| Java | javac/JVM | Java API and JAR build |
| Python | CPython | Python package/API |

GCC documents C, C++, Objective-C and Objective-C++ front ends. The .NET SDK provides the CLI, runtime and libraries, while Roslyn exposes compiler APIs. Python documents the standard library and C API.
